## om10mi-mods { #om10mi-mods }

Film looks, Per-sector colour editor, Per-look colour editor.

**v94** · Stock firmware 1.4
{ .release-scope }

No camera test recorded for this release. See the camera report for [87](../evidence/em10-v87-owner.md).

Unofficial, for the E-M10 Mark I on firmware 1.4 only; made and tested on a single body. No warranty; installing custom firmware is risky. The ART dial no longer reaches the stock art filters.
{ .release-warning }

[Install guide](https://github.com/Meghnus/om10mi-mods/blob/84d4f36365270a9393d0b46b8beeae44a8e3491d/INSTALL.md){ .btn .btn-primary } · [Release notes & files](https://github.com/Meghnus/om10mi-mods/releases/tag/v94)

<details class="mod-details" markdown="1"><summary>Features and examples</summary>

- **Film looks.** 18 looks in Picture Mode, the SCP menu, Live View and RAW Data Edit, including Portra 400, Kodachrome 64, Ektar 100 and Gold 200, each with its own icon since 87; Contrast, Sharpness, Highlight, Shadow and Gradation act on them.
- **Per-sector colour editor.** Hue, Saturation and Lightness for 12 named colour sectors, also per bank in RAW Data Edit.
- **Per-look colour editor.** Each colour look has its own User Hue page (Picture Mode, highlight the look, right arrow) with Sector, Hue, Sector Sat and Lightness; it moved there from the Custom page in 88.

</details>

[Full project details](../projects/om10mi-mods.md#for-em10)
